architecture: A stable copy of Harness called the working checkout as an external tool; the Harness did not invoke a model.

initial_environment_run.finding: The pinned pytest command could not run in the isolated standard-library environment.
initial_environment_run.response: The failed gate was retained; the Run was closed partial and a new standard-library Run was started.

implemented_scope: Default Job summaries validate v2 observation references.
Closed Run recovery validates referenced Job measurements.
Assessment citations classify current and contextual bindings.
Persisted terminal limit transitions replay the original error after caller restart.
Product-specific caller naming was removed from general usage documentation.
limitations: The controlling Harness was the stable 0.3.0 checkout, so its final assessment record does not contain the new citation binding fields; those fields were verified inside the Candidate regression suite.
Display-status composition, a reusable caller integration profile, measurement environment terminology, and path-independent Domain identity remain follow-up work.
No protected Ready certificate or external model-quality benchmark is claimed.
